medium.en: Hanging scroll; ink and colour on silk

institution.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
institution.credit_line: The Howard Mansfield Collection, Purchase, Rogers Fund, 1936

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1877. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1877 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A pale silk hanging scroll: a faint full moon in a misty sky above soft grey hills, a band of low cloud across the middle, and at the bottom a few dark trees and reeds at the water's edge.
alt.zh: 一幅淡色的绢本立轴：雾蒙蒙的天空里一轮淡淡的满月，下面是柔和的灰色山丘，中段横着一带低云，底部水边有几棵深色的树和一丛芦苇。

note.en: Attributed to Shiokawa Bunrin, a Kyoto painter of the Shijō school, which favoured soft washes and observed nature over bold outlines. Almost nothing here is drawn with a line: moon, hills and mist are all pools of diluted ink on silk. It is the quietest night on this wall.
note.zh: 传为盐川文麟所作。他是京都四条派画家，这一派偏爱柔和的渲染和对自然的观察，而不是浓重的轮廓线。这里几乎没有一根线：月、山、雾，都是绢上一汪汪淡墨。这是这面墙上最安静的一夜。
